jcr:title: OSGi Fundamentals for Content Management
author: cms-admin
body:
OSGi (Open Service Gateway initiative) is the modular system that powers Apache Sling. It provides a dynamic component system for Java that allows applications to be composed of small, reusable, and collaborative components.

In the context of content management, OSGi enables dynamic deployment of services, automatic dependency management, and runtime service discovery. This makes Sling applications highly modular and maintainable.

Key OSGi concepts include bundles (JAR files with metadata), services (interfaces with implementations), and the service registry for dynamic binding.
summary: Understanding OSGi, the foundation of modular applications in Apache Sling.
tags: OSGi, Modular Architecture, Service Registry, Bundles, Dynamic Deployment
title: OSGi Fundamentals for Content Management
